quarterly_data.signal: First half to September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 163,756 million (-1.1%), operating profit JPY 19,152 million (+37.2%), ordinary profit JPY 18,944 million (+39.2%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 12,145 million (+4.3%). Management: sales of semiconductor-related products were firm, but caustic soda export volumes fell and overseas vinyl chloride prices declined; operating profit rose on firm semiconductor-related sales and manufacturing cost improvements. Other segments (sales / operating profit): Chemicals JPY 52,347 million (-8.6%) / JPY 5,624 million (+6.8%); Cement JPY 32,422 million (+0.5%) / JPY 4,835 million (+31.2%); Life Science JPY 19,286 million (-3.6%) / JPY 4,016 million (+3.7%); Environment JPY 2,681 million (+37.8%) / JPY 256 million (prior-year operating loss JPY 220 million).

quarterly_data.signal: Electronic & Advanced Materials segment, first half to September 2025 (semi-annual report, management's analysis): semiconductor-grade polycrystalline silicon earned more on an improved operating rate and a reversal of inventory valuation losses; IC chemicals improved as sales volumes of high-purity isopropyl alcohol for electronics manufacturing increased; dry silica earned less on lower export volumes; thermal management materials earned more as sales volumes rose, mainly for semiconductor production equipment. Segment sales JPY 42,586 million (+7.1%), operating profit JPY 6,972 million (+140.5%).
